title: Teach the refresh guard the HTML order table, failing test first
goal: A refresh that only drops Done order items merges itself again
acceptance: A committed test in test/refresh-guard.test.mjs with an HTML order table fails before the fix
closedRefs reads Closed items from both the Markdown and the HTML layout; an item not Closed is still refused
validation: npm test; check:fast; final applicable CI; the next refresh that drops a Done item merges itself

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one parser and one test, the same shape as the views-changed HTML change. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-26: closedRefs reads HTML rows too; failing-first test committed before the fix.

privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
